review_locator: PMCID:PMC6290922, T-bet: a bridge between innate and adaptive immunity
primary_title: Signal transducer and activator of transcription 4 is required for the transcription factor T-bet to promote T helper 1 cell-fate determination
decision_basis: The review identifies XCL1 as a T-bet-controlled Th1 chemokine locus; the cited primary shows T-bet-dependent Xcl1 expression in IL-12-polarized CD4-positive Th1 cells and T-bet/STAT4-dependent chromatin activation at the Xcl1 promoter.
limitations_preserved: Promote only the bounded T-bet/STAT4-associated XCL1 gene-regulation bridge in mouse Th1 cells. Preserve the IL-12/anti-IL-4, restimulation and cooperative STAT4 context; XCL1 transcription does not by itself prove chemokine protein secretion, XCR1 activation, SCI effects or terminal-TF effects automatically.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC6290922, T-bet: a bridge between innate and adaptive immunity
primary_title: The transcription factor T-bet is induced by multiple pathways and prevents an endogenous Th2 program during T helper 1 responses
decision_basis: The review identifies CCR6 as a T-bet-opposed Th17-associated receptor locus; the cited primary demonstrates T-bet binding within a Ccr6 intron, T-bet-dependent H3K27me3 deposition and repression of Ccr6 expression in Th1 cells.
limitations_preserved: Promote only the bounded T-bet-associated Ccr6 gene-repression bridge in Th1 cells. The primary maps an intronic regulatory site and epigenetic repression rather than a simple promoter interaction; preserve cell-state and chromatin context, and do not infer CCR6 protein abundance, CCL20 signaling, SCI effects or terminal-TF effects automatically.
